title: Microsoft Teams: Android device management moves to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
summary: Hold: the readiness checklist gives the public-cloud minimum Admin Agent version without the higher government-cloud requirement. The briefing also overlooks documented licence restrictions on Teams Rooms update rings and excludes custom-role holders who can assign roles.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Teams Android device management is transitioning from TAC to PMP.
claims.quote: we are transitioning Teams Android device management from the Teams admin center (TAC) to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal (PMP).

claims.claim: The affected devices are Teams Rooms on Android, Teams phones, Teams panels and SIP phones.
claims.quote: Admins who manage Teams Rooms on Android, Teams phones, Teams panels, and SIP Phones.

claims.claim: Teams Displays management will not migrate, in line with the Teams Displays app end of support.
claims.quote: The management of Teams Displays won't be migrated from Teams Admin Center to Teams Rooms Pro Management portal. This is in line with the end of support for the Teams Displays app.

claims.claim: PMP becomes the primary portal for all Teams device management.
claims.quote: PMP will become the primary portal for all Teams device management.

claims.claim: PMP provides device inventories with metadata and app information.
claims.quote: Device inventories for Android-based Teams Rooms, phones, and panels, including metadata and app information

claims.claim: PMP remote actions include restart, log collection, sign-in/out and provisioning.
claims.quote: Remote device actions (restart, log collection, sign-in/out, provisioning, and more)

claims.claim: PMP provides update management.
claims.quote: The following capabilities will be available and enhanced in PMP: ... Update management

claims.claim: PMP provides device settings and configuration profiles.
claims.quote: Device settings and configuration profiles.

claims.claim: PMP provides device health monitoring.
claims.quote: Device health monitoring

claims.claim: PMP provides SIP device management.
claims.quote: SIP device management
